emitterMapping.negativeFinding: The three known 0x00ca emitters do not expose a generic Application::Scene::ScenePacket record_id -> outbound opcode switch table. FUN_004DC690 switches on inbound/network packet opcode fields, while FUN_00589030 and FUN_0058E0C0 emit from actor dirty/movement state. The scripted pass can therefore promote only the position/direction state path already correlated through FUN_0075F120.

negativeFindings: No generic record_id -> outbound opcode dispatch table was found for the known 0x00ca emitters.
Most of the 190 FUN_004D7980 callers are scene/UI/actor state posters with no Lua N-API path at BFS depth <= 7.
Direct-emission Lua APIs that bypass FUN_004D7980 remain out of scope here.
